map.：6000px 宽 @300dpi：打印宽 = 6000÷300 = 20in: : 6000 px wide @ 300 dpi: print width = 6000/300 = 20 in ~ 50.8 cm; at only 150 dpi it is 40 in, with obvious graininess up close.
map.：想印 A4 宽 21cm @300dpi：所需像素 = 21÷2.54×300: : want to print A4 width 21 cm @ 300 dpi: required pixels = 21/2.54*300 ~ 2480 px, below this prints blurry.
map.近距离观看 300dpi 细腻，远观海报 150dpi 即可；视距越大可接受越低: Close viewing is fine at 300 dpi, a distant poster is fine at 150 dpi; the greater the viewing distance, the lower the acceptable DPI.
map.插值只能柔化放大、不增真实细节；原像素不足印大尺寸必糊，应前期拍高分辨率。: Interpolation can only soften enlargement, not add real detail; insufficient original pixels will blur at large print sizes, so shoot high resolution up front.
